chunks: Three narrators — one of them is Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id — narrated to us Ali ibn al-Hasan at-Taymali in Safar of the year four and seventy of the two hundredth century — he narrated to me Muhammad ibn Ali — from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Buzay' — from al-Mansur ibn Yunus ibn Bazraj — from al-Hamzah ibn Hamran — from al-Salim al-Ashjal — who said: I heard Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him) saying:

Moses ibn Imran looked in the first Book (Pentateuch) at what would be given to the Qa'im of the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) in terms of authority and virtue, so Moses said: 'My Lord, make me the Qa'im of the Family of Muhammad.' It was said to him: 'Indeed, he is from the progeny of Ahmad.' Then he looked in the second Book and found the same thing, so he said the same, and it was said to him the same. Then he looked in the third Book and saw the same, so he said the same, and it was said to him the same.

key_terms.آل محمد: The Family of Muhammad, referring to the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.ذرية أحمد: Progeny of Ahmad (a name of Prophet Muhammad)
key_terms.فضل: Virtue, grace, or superior spiritual rank
key_terms.قائم: The Awaited One, specifically referring to Imam al-Mahdi (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Moses ask for when he read about the Qa'im in his scripture?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the pre-existence of the Qa'im in the divine records, illustrating the continuity of prophetic recognition across different eras. It underscores the Shia belief in the unique, divinely ordained status of the Ahl al-Bayt, where even a great prophet like Musa acknowledges the superior lineage of Muhammad (peace be upon him). The repetition of the query emphasizes the certainty and prominence of this figure in Islamic eschatology.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (34) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed bin Oqda narrated from Ali bin al-Hasan at-Taymali from Muhammad bin Ali from Muhammad bin Issma’eel bin Buzay’ from Mansoor bin Younus bin Bazraj from Hamza bin Hamran from Salim al-Ashall that Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said:

“Prophet Moses (as) looked up in the first Pentateuch what abilities and virtues would be given to al-Qa’im of Muhammad’s family and then he said: “O my Lord, make me al-Qa’im of Muhammad’s family!” It was said to him: “He is from Muhammad’s progeny.” He looked up in the second Pentateuch and he found the same things. He prayed Allah for the same thing and he was answered with the same answer. Then he opened the third Pentateuch and found the same thing. He asked his Lord for the same thing and the same was said to him.”
